name: @pipeworx/mcp-sciencebase

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the USGS ScienceBase catalog (sciencebase.gov) — the U.S. Geological Survey's scientific data catalog of datasets, publications, and projects, with summaries, categories, dates, and direct download links. Keyless.

category.description: Optional. Narrow to a single catalog category: "Data", "Publication", "Project", or "Collection".

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get a single ScienceBase catalog item by id — full summary, categories, types, dates, contacts, web links, and attached files (download URLs). e.g. id "58f8be37e4b0b7ea5452260e". Keyless.

id.description: A ScienceBase item id, e.g. "58f8be37e4b0b7ea5452260e" (from search_items results).

tools.name: item_children
tools.description: List the child items of a ScienceBase catalog item. The catalog is hierarchical — collections and folders contain sub-items (use get_item to check has_children). Keyless.

parent_id.description: The id of the parent catalog item, e.g. "58e64ab1e4b09da6799ac732".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sciencebase forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sciencebase pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
